cohort: 358 pregnant women with or without COVID-19 diagnosis
finding: COVID-19 disease during pregnancy was associated with higher rates of maternal hypertensive disease, preterm birth, low birth weight, low Apgar scores, and need for neonatal intensive care.
mod_finding: The frequency of cesarean section was highest in those diagnosed with COVID-19 in the 3rd trimester, while it was lowest in those diagnosed in the first trimester.
